name: Uvs Nuur Basin
description: The Uvs Nuur Basin straddles the border between northwest Mongolia and Russia's Tuva region. Its centrepiece is Uvs Nuur, a huge, shallow, salty lake that draws migrating birds. Around it, twelve protected areas span desert, steppe and mountains, where rare jerboas and marbled polecats live in the lowlands and snow leopards, argali sheep and Asiatic ibex roam the peaks.
